title: Implement range Slice A contract and vertical layout repair
description: Apply the first implementation slice from the range audit: clarify current value labels versus scale ticks, stop disabled vertical rails from reserving layout, and improve long-value handling without adding broad customization.
objective: Fix the mechanical range component contract exposed by the vertical screenshot while keeping the implementation small, testable, and derived from TASK-FC-006.
expected_outputs: Range copy distinguishes current value labels from scale ticks
Range wrapper exposes explicit value/tick/input state classes
Vertical CSS stops hidden rails from reserving layout
Long range values have overflow handling
Mechanical verification plus Guilherme visual QA scenario
acceptance_criteria: The Style tab copy makes current value labels and scale ticks distinct.
Disabling current values or ticks removes their vertical rail from layout.
The existing range save/load and runtime behavior remains compatible.
The slice does not add broad deferred controls from the audit.
Guilherme remains responsible for nuanced Elementor visual QA.
verification: PHP lint passes for changed PHP files.
git diff --check passes in root and plugin.
Generated range markup exposes the expected state classes.
Guilherme performs frontend/editor visual QA for vertical mode.

budgets.context_budget: range render, range style controls, range CSS

risks: Changing vertical grid rules can improve contract but still require Guilherme's visual judgment.
Native range input browser differences remain outside this slice.
